articles.headline: Japan ramping up defence is 'critical' to prevent war, Defence Minister Koizumi tells BBC
articles.summary: Japan needs to revisit the pacifist posture that has defined it since World War Two, Shinjiro Koizumi says.
articles._summary: Japan must "strengthen its defence capabilities", Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi has told the BBC, emphasising the need to revisit the pacifist posture that has defined the country since World War Two. He said boosting defence, "reinforcing its alliance with the United States, and expanding collaboration with like-minded countries" was part of "building multi-layered deterrence critical for ensuring that no new war breaks out in this region". He spoke of the recent changes in Japan's defence policy, such as relaxing decades-old arms export rules. For the first time in about 50 years, Tokyo can now sell or transfer defence equipment and lethal weapons to the 17 countries with which it has signed formal agreements, including the US and the UK. "Australia has selected Japanese war ships. Discussions are under way with the Philippines for used destroyers from Japan's Maritime Self-Defence Force.
articles._zh_headline: 日本防卫大臣小泉纯一郎告诉 BBC，日本加强防卫对于防止战争“至关重要”
articles._zh_summary: 日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎告诉英国广播公司，日本必须“加强其防御能力”，并强调有必要重新审视自第二次世界大战以来日本所采取的和平主义姿态。他表示，加强国防、“加强与美国的联盟、扩大与志同道合的国家的合作”是“建立多层次威慑力量的一部分，这对于确保该地区不再爆发新的战争至关重要”。他谈到了日本防务政策最近的变化，例如放宽了数十年的武器出口规则。大约 50 年来，东京首次可以向其签署正式协议的 17 个国家出售或转让防御装备和致命武器，其中包括美国和英国。 “澳大利亚已经选择了日本战舰。正在与菲律宾讨论使用日本海上自卫队的二手驱逐舰。

articles.author: Erica Kollmann
articles.headline: Apple Will Raise Prices Due To Soaring Memory Costs: CEO Tim Cook Says 'This Is A 100-Year Flood'
articles.summary: Apple will raise prices across its product lineup due to soaring memory chip costs, CEO Tim Cook says.
articles._summary: “Unfortunately, price increases are unavoidable,” Cook said in a Wall Street Journal interview published Wednesday. “We’re doing our best to mitigate the huge increases that are being passed to us, but the situation has become unsustainable.” Cook declined to specify which devices will see higher sticker tags or when changes will take effect. Apple's next major launch — the iPhone 18 lineup, which is anticipated to include a foldable model — is expected in September.
articles._zh_headline: 苹果因内存成本飙升将提价：CEO蒂姆·库克称“这是一场100年一遇的洪水”
articles._zh_summary: “不幸的是，价格上涨是不可避免的，”库克在周三发表的《华尔街日报》采访中表示。 “我们正在尽最大努力减轻传递给我们的巨大增长，但情况已经变得不可持续。”库克拒绝具体说明哪些设备将看到更高的贴纸标签或更改何时生效。苹果的下一次重大发布——iPhone 18 系列，预计将包括可折叠机型——预计将于 9 月发布。

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Nvidia Supplier SK Hynix Ships Next-Generation HBM Memory Samples To Major Customers
articles.summary: SK Hynix shipped samples of its next-generation HBM4E AI memory chips to major customers as demand for AI infrastructure surge.
articles._summary: In a statement, the South Korean memory giant said that it has started supplying samples of its next-generation 12-layer HBM4E chips for customer evaluation. The new memory delivers transfer speeds of up to 16 gigabits per second per pin and offers more than 20% better power efficiency compared with previous-generation products. HBM is a critical component in AI accelerators and graphics processors because it enables faster movement of massive datasets required to train and run advanced AI models.
articles._zh_headline: Nvidia 供应商 SK Hynix 向主要客户提供下一代 HBM 内存样品
articles._zh_summary: 这家韩国内存巨头在一份声明中表示，已开始提供下一代 12 层 HBM4E 芯片的样品以供客户评估。与上一代产品相比，新款内存的每引脚传输速度高达 16 GB/秒，能效提高 20% 以上。 HBM 是 AI 加速器和图形处理器的关键组件，因为它可以更快地移动训练和运行高级 AI 模型所需的海量数据集。
